0022600221.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-4, on a one-game losing streak and 10th in the West, 2 games back in the Northwest) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, winners of their last game, 7th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Southwest). Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain), while Memphis is missing Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-119 win in Denver on April 8, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
